launcher.catalog: As browser_schema_owner insert organization_id, project_id, application_id, input_id, registration_pin, spec, projection_sha256 and rendered_driver_sha256 into public.mixer_managed_linux_pair25_starters. Use starter-<manifest SHA-256> as input_id and the manifest SHA-256 as registration_pin. The other columns must exactly match the pinned manifest.

launcher.workerGrant: The launcher provisions the private one-operation grant from the committed queued-to-running attempt, separately from the Starter catalog.

managedLinux.observations: Missing and mismatched catalog, malformed and stale manifests, wrong scope, non-owner, invalid CSRF, direct SQL authorization and shared advisory-lock conflict refused. Owner list/select/reselect and verified-input list matched the exact DTO. A changed policy caused conflict. Build POST returned 201 and replay returned 200 with the same queued build. Exactly one input with (1,1200000,0), one build, and one available job. Reservation and billing rows stayed equal.

Fixture preparation used the pinned source templates and verified SDK archives. The worker query proof reported zero starts.
